# N. Short title of the decision

## Status

Proposed | Accepted | Superseded by ADR-XXXX

## Context

What is the problem or force at play? What constraints, requirements, or prior
decisions are relevant? Keep this factual and neutral.

## Decision

The change being made, stated in active voice ("We will ..."). Be specific enough
that a reader can tell whether a future change conflicts with it.

## Consequences

What becomes easier or harder as a result? List follow-ups, risks, and any
conditions under which this decision should be revisited.
